Acceptance: Placement supervised; vibration monitored; curing maintained; test samples | Cl. 4.3 — Concrete execution | | | B4 | Bearing seat preparation and level check
Acceptance: Seat level ±10 mm; surface finish acceptable; protection until bearing | Cl. 4.4 — Bearing surface | | | B5 | Substructure defect checklist (QC-BRG-CHK-002)
Acceptance: Report completed and signed | Cl. 4.5 — QC approval | | | C. BEARING INSTALLATION INSPECTION | | C1 | Bearing type and dimension verification
